confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Dutch city price levels, not checked against live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than July hostel and hotel rates, which vary widely with events and demand. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange rates overview page dated 15 October 2026; I did not open that page directly, and third-party sites showed different figures for 16 October.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Dutch university and tourism cities, priced somewhat below Amsterdam, with July peak-season accommodation rates.
